operations.name: Saw Blanks to Length
operations.setup_note: Clamp the supplied bright bar in the saw vice against a length stop and cut individual blanks with facing allowance at both ends. Material arrives in the assumed supplied 30–38 HRC condition.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the -X portion of the sawn blank, expose the +X end and face F02 as a process axial reference. Cleanup-finish F06 to establish Datum A, then machine the coaxial blind internal thread in the same chucking.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Flip into bored soft jaws on finished Datum A, stop axially against F02 and indicate the datum cylinder before cutting; use a traveling steady rest to control the reduced-section overhang. Run the consolidated G71/G70 profile, including the shoulder face and integral F05 fillet, then cut the baseline relief before external threading.

operations.name: Production Deburr / Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the completed pin in a nonmarring cradle and make one fast production pass to remove residual thread-start or runout burrs not removed by the lathe chamfers. Wash away chips and cutting-fluid residue without polishing the taper or changing the relief profile.

operations.name: Batch Phosphate Coat
operations.setup_note: Batch the 100-piece order on the in-house phosphate line using protective fixtures for the provisionally excluded threads, taper and datum cylinder. Integrate chemical preparation, masking, phosphate treatment, rinsing, unmasking and any PS-119.0-required embrittlement relief into this single line operation.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Gauge Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate on Datum A for SPC checks using dedicated dimensional, thread and runout gauges, and verify coating appearance and material certification. Perform the sampled SAE J491a master-gage bluing check as the second manual inspection sub-operation, requiring at least 60% satisfactorily distributed taper contact.

clarifications.question: May the permitted SAE 4140 alternative be purchased already quenched and tempered to 30–38 HRC, without heat treatment after machining?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use certified pre-quenched-and-tempered SAE 4140 bright bar at 30–38 HRC with minimum yield strength of 100,000 psi; omit subsequent heat treatment.

clarifications.question: Which permitted thread-relief configuration is required for F01?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the canonical front-view relief; do not apply the optional-detail limits cumulatively.

clarifications.question: Which three edges receive the 3X .02-inch × 45-degree chamfer callout?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply these chamfers to the +X body outside edge, internal-thread entrance and outside edge of the large-body shoulder; retain the separate .07-inch external-thread entry chamfer.

clarifications.question: What surfaces are permitted to remain uncoated under PS-119.0?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally protect F03, F04, F06 and F07 against coating buildup and phosphate F01, F02 and F05; obtain approval before releasing coating.

clarifications.question: Can you provide the applicable revision of phosphate specification PS-119.0?
What sampling frequency is required for the SAE J491a master-gage bluing contact test?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use an approved 1-in-50 sampling plan, giving two checks for this 100-piece order, with every checked pin meeting the 60% minimum distributed-contact requirement.

clarifications.question: Does the 1.25 ± .06-inch blind-hole depth refer to full-diameter drilled depth or drill-tip depth?
clarifications.suggested_default: Interpret it as full-diameter drilled depth, with at least 1.00 inch of full internal thread and adequate tool-bottom clearance.

assumptions.text: All linear feature values and tolerances labeled _mm are actually inches, as explicitly stated in the feature graph. Convert them by 25.4 before downstream calculations; the maximum envelope is Ø54.102 × 204.724 mm.
The 100 and 125 surface-finish callouts are Ra microinches, equivalent to 2.54 and 3.175 micrometres. There is no explicit grind callout, so finish turning is used without grinding.

The route selects the expressly permitted SAE 4140 alternative supplied at 30–38 HRC and certified to the stated minimum yield strength. The hardness requirement is treated as a supplied-material condition, not a mandatory post-machining thermal cycle; this interpretation requires C01 approval.

Because the permitted hardness is a range rather than a known measured value, scalar hardness fields remain null. Machinability is medium for this supplied 30–38 HRC alloy steel; no route operation performs hardening.

Ø54.5 mm bright bar is provisionally assumed to be commercially procurable in the selected condition and is the near-net stock choice above the Ø54.102 mm maximum envelope. The 210 mm cut length provides 5.276 mm beyond the maximum finished length; confirm stock availability before purchasing.

F01 uses the baseline front-view profile. The optional undercut detail is an alternative configuration of the same relief, not another groove, and its limits are not combined with the baseline limits.

F06 receives only a finish cleanup skim, not major-OD roughing. Separate roughing sub-operations apply only to the reduced taper envelope and external-thread blank; they are portions of one consolidated canned cycle rather than overlapping full-stock removals.

The F05 shoulder fillet is formed integrally with the finish taper profile under the organizational canned-cycle correction, despite its separately toleranced radius. The second-end shoulder-facing pass establishes the F06 body length.

The blind internal thread is single-point cut using the listed CNC-lathe threading capability rather than assuming rigid tapping equipment. Dedicated rough and finish boring are omitted because F07 has no separately specified precision unthreaded bore; the drilled minor-diameter preparation supports thread cutting.

Support-only center drilling is omitted because a traveling steady rest supports the reduced-section overhang without creating an additional center feature. Part-off is omitted because individually sawn blanks are faced at both ends.

Hole-making pilot drilling, deep-hole peck drilling, reaming, precision boring, honing and fastener-seat counterboring/countersinking are not applicable to this single shallow threaded hole. Its entrance edge is handled by chamfer turning before the final internal-thread cut.

No milling route is applicable: the flat end face is rotational and is faced on the lathe, and all hole features are coaxial. No VMC setup, forging, fixture fabrication, intermediate inspection or CMM layout is added.
One fast bench pass is retained for residual threading burrs beyond the reach of programmed chamfers. It includes cleaning but no hand polishing or dimensional finishing.

All standalone heat-treatment-template steps are omitted because the assumed purchased material already provides the required condition. If C01 instead requires post-machining heat treatment, the route must be revised to include a single vendor process before coating, without automatically adding post-treatment machining or grinding.

Surface-treatment cleaning, masking, phosphate application, unmasking and any specification-required embrittlement relief are consolidated into one in-house batch-line operation. Organic-coating cure is not applicable, and coating inspection is included in the sole final gate.

Pending PS-119.0 approval, the standard treatment template's protection of threads and precision mating surfaces is retained. Consequently the provisional phosphate sub-operation targets only F01, F02 and F05; C04 blocks release of this masking interpretation.

The final gate uses dedicated shop-floor gauges under SPC and includes the master-gage contact test. Both checks use manual_inspect because bluing is a manual functional gauge check; no separate test operation is created.

Inspection, cleaning and masking do not physically produce geometric features, so their target lists are empty. Sawing produces a blank rather than a finished drawing feature, so its target list is also empty.
